title: Find My Career Track — Free IT & CAD Career Quiz | techcadd Lucknow
metaDescription: Four quick questions to find your optimal IT or CAD track: Full Stack, AI & Data, Cybersecurity & Cloud, Digital Marketing, or CAD. Get matched courses and a free 90-day action roadmap.

hero.text: Four questions, then a 90-day plan you can actually follow: the course that fits, the job titles to apply for, and what to build first. Download it as a PDF. No form, no email, no catch.

inputs.behaviour: Click an option -> highlights for 240ms then auto-advances; 'Back' button shown when n>1 (goes back one question).

logic: Each option maps to one category. After 4 answers, count answers per category; winner = category with the highest count, ties broken by the order of the categories list [ai-data, development, cyber-cloud, digital-marketing, cad-design, programming] (first with the max count wins; strict > comparison). Recommended course = courseByCategory[winner].

result.container: #career-roadmap (print CSS hides everything else so 'Download as PDF' = window.print())
result.heading: {category.title} (with category icon)
